atomic_facts.fact: Do Kwon's full legal name is Do Kwon (Korean name 권도형)
Do Kwon is a South Korean cryptocurrency executive
Do Kwon is the cofounder of Singapore-based Terraform Labs
Do Kwon is a South Korean national
Do Kwon was indicted on nine counts
The nine-count indictment covered securities fraud, wire fraud, commodities fraud and money-laundering conspiracy
In August 2025 Do Kwon pleaded guilty to two fraud counts
The two counts were conspiracy to commit commodities fraud, securities fraud and wire fraud, and wire fraud
Seven other counts were dropped as part of the plea deal
He was not acquitted of any US fraud charge
A civil jury had already found him liable for securities fraud in April 2024
